[[Screecher]] is a [[Harpy]] [[boss]] that appears in the [[Wilderness of Bahdza]] only before the completion of the [[quest]] [[Destroy the Harpies]] and during [[Population Control]]. After defeating this boss, all nearby harpies will cease attacking you and flee to [[Resplendent Makuun]].

==Locations==
* [[Vabbi]]
** {{NPC location|Wilderness of Bahdza}} (before Destroy the Harpies and during Population Control)

==Skills==
* {{skill icon|"Incoming!"}} ([[elite]])
* {{skill icon|"We Shall Return!"}}
* {{skill icon|Aggressive Refrain}}
* {{skill icon|Harrier's Toss}}
* {{skill icon|Wild Throw}}

==Notes==
*When Screecher and her group are killed, another group of elite skree will spawn. Shortly after spawning, the group will flee to the [[Resplendent Makuun]] portal and disappear.
* If [[Scratcher]] is still alive, the harpies near her will remain until she also is defeated.
